_readme: Per-scene camera defaults, applied when the OBS PROGRAM scene changes.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: OBS filters live on the SOURCE, not the scene, so a filter
toggled in one scene is toggled in all of them - and zoom is not an OBS property at
all, it is a setting on the phone. Neither can be made scene-dependent by OBS alone.
This is applied by dash.py's scene watcher instead.
Only the keys present are applied. Omit 'zoom' to leave zoom alone; omit a filter
name to leave that filter alone. A scene with no entry here is never touched.
Edit by hand, or set a look up in OBS and press Capture on the Cams tab.
